newsitem.title: USA: Penn Octane to name new management team.
newsitem.headline: Penn Octane to name new management team.

text.p: Penn Octane Corp said on Monday that it expects J.B. Richter, the company's largest shareholder, to be named chairman, president and chief executive at a board meeting to be held on Tuesday.

The company said it also expects Ian Bothwell, the founder of Bothwell & Asociados SA de CV, a management consulting and financial advisory company, will be named vice president, treasurer and chief financial officer.
Jorge Bracamontes, the president of Penn Octane de Mexico, an affiliate, is expected to become a vice president and secretary of the company.
